Ideogram-slice blocks

Source: R/seq_block.R
seq_block.Rd

Draws one block per range: a rectangle (or an arrow strip) spanning the exact track positions [x, x_end], filled either with a solid colour or with the cytobands of a reference interval chrom:ref_start-ref_end mapped into the block, mirrored when the block is flipped. A centromere interval is drawn as a red bowtie with the outline on the arms only. Labels sit inside the block when requested and they fit, otherwise outside (above or below) with a three-level stagger. Useful for synteny, rearrangement and assembly figures where pieces of reference chromosomes are laid out along new coordinates.

Usage

seq_block(
  data = NULL,
  mapping = NULL,
  aesthetics = aes(),
  fill = c("solid", "cytoband"),
  cytobands = NULL,
  palette = NULL,
  tints = c(0.15, 0.5, 0.3, 0.65, 0.4),
  block_colors = NULL,
  shape = c("rect", "arrow"),
  height = 0.5,
  label_side = c("below", "above"),
  flip_style = c("rotate", "overline", "minus"),
  annotations = NULL,
  legend = NULL,
  show_legend = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

GRanges whose seqnames are the track windows the blocks sit in and whose ranges are the block positions in track coordinates.

mapping

Optional SeqMap. Fields (all optional): x, x_end (exact numeric block edges; default start, end); chrom, ref_start, ref_end (reference interval drawn inside the block, half-open; default seqnames, x, x_end); flipped (mirror the reference interval); label; key (fill key or a colour; default chrom); tint (integer tint index; default 1); label_inside; dashed (dashed outline); centromere_start, centromere_end (reference coordinates; NA means none).

aesthetics

Optional SeqAes. Keys: outline.col (default "grey25"), outline.lwd (0.7), label.size (cex, 0.7), label.col ("black"), centromere.fill ("#D33A2C"), fade (alpha of a white overlay, 0), arrow.head (maximum head length as a fraction of block width, 0.35), arrow.head_max (maximum head length as a fraction of the track width, 0.012).

fill

"solid" (default) or "cytoband". Blocks with no matching cytobands fall back to solid with a message.

cytobands

Cytoband table: a GRanges as returned by load_cytobands() or a data frame with chrom, start (0-based), end, stain (UCSC chromStart, chromEnd, gieStain also work). NULL loads the bundled hg38 bands. Chromosome names are matched with or without a chr prefix.

palette

NULL (default hues), "soft" (a softer set), or a character vector of colours. A named vector is looked up by key; an unnamed one is recycled over the distinct keys in data order.

tints

Fractions mixed toward white, indexed by tint.

block_colors

Optional named colours overriding the fill by label, then by key (not tinted).

shape

"rect" (default) or "arrow" (solid strips pointing toward increasing reference coordinate, reversed when flipped).

height

Block height as a fraction of the panel height. Default 0.5.

label_side

"below" (default) or "above" for outside labels.

flip_style

How flipped blocks are marked: "rotate" (label rotated 180 degrees), "overline" (line over the label) or "minus" (a leading minus sign).

annotations

Optional data frame of point or interval annotations with columns chrom, start, optional end, label, and optional side ("above"/"below"), color, italic, dot, strand ("+"/"-" draws a direction arrow). Each row is drawn on every block whose reference interval contains its midpoint, mapped through flips.

legend

Optional LegendKey list or SeqLegendSpec. No legend is generated automatically.

show_legend

Logical. Default TRUE.

...

Additional arguments reserved for future use.

Value

A SeqBlockR6 instance.

Examples

gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges("der1", IRanges::IRanges(c(1, 3e7), c(3e7, 6e7)),
                             label = c("A", "B"), flipped = c(FALSE, TRUE))
seq_block(gr, map(label = label, flipped = flipped, chrom = "chr1"))
